## June 18th: Landmarks in southwest Iceland

<!-- {{< fa gavel >}} Thingvellir is the site of Iceland's parliament from the 10th the 18th century

{{< fa hot-tub-person >}} Geysir, a.k.a. The *Great Geysir*, is a hot spring and geothermal area

{{< fa water >}} Gullfoss, a.k.a. *Golden Falls*, is a huge two-tiered waterfall -->
3. Thingvellir is the site of Iceland's parliament from the 10th the 18th century
4. Geysir, a.k.a. The *Great Geysir*, is a hot spring and geothermal area
5. Gullfoss, a.k.a. *Golden Falls*, is a huge two-tiered waterfall

:::
